affinity.notes: The creature is entirely grounded in flesh, bone, and physical mutation with no dominant elemental effect.

anatomy.notes: Exaggerated arms, rib cage, head, and stance remain functionally coherent.

archetype.notes: Bruiser does not communicate the intended plague-pump route-control duty.

counterplay.notes: The forward lunge telegraphs a close-range rush, while the exposed chest and abdomen present an obvious vulnerable zone.

finish.notes: Convincing flesh, bone, and grime rendering.

framing.notes: Aggressive forward posture fills the card without harmful clipping.

identity.notes: Corpse ogre or stitched revenant identifies the Rot Brute form.

tier.notes: Blind reviewer perceived T3; exact intended tier is T3.
